learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the magic words that tell us exactly how, when, and where an action happens!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: An adverb is a word that adds extra details to a verb! Just like adjectives describe nouns, adverbs describe actions. They answer questions like How? When? and Where?
These adverbs tell us HOW an action is done. Many of them end in '-ly'. For example: The turtle walks SLOWLY. The children laughed LOUDLY.
Some adverbs tell us WHEN something happens (yesterday, now, soon). Others tell us WHERE it happens (here, there, outside). Example: 'We are playing OUTSIDE NOW.'

fun_activity.title: 🎭 The Acting Game
fun_activity.instructions: Stand up and walk around the room. First, walk 'quietly'. Then, walk 'quickly'. Finally, walk 'happily'. You just acted out three different adverbs of manner!

quick_recap: ⭐ Adverbs are special words that describe verbs or actions.
⭐ Adverbs of manner often end in '-ly' and tell us how an action is done.
⭐ Adverbs also tell us the exact time (when) and place (where) of an action!
